Two Indian students die in Canada flight training accident

Two Indian students, identified as Manoj Sivakumar from Tamil Nadu and Srisaran Thirugnanasambantham from Puducherry, died in an air accident in Canada. The incident occurred during flight training, and the Indian mission confirmed their deaths. The accident took place in Canada.
